Read on with `seed_show({seed: "<id>", since: <N>})` or `seed_show({seed: "<id>", since: 12})`, and search with `seed_search({query: "two words", limit: <n>})`. `lines: <n>` picks the last lines of `terminal_read({terminal: "<terminal>"})`.

    seed_show({seed: "<id>", since: <N>})   only what was saved after bookmark N

Skip what you have read with `seed_show({seed: "<id>", since: …})`.
